description:
Add command history to the input/editor component:
- Up arrow recalls previous input, Down returns toward current
- History persisted to ~/.octo_pi/history (one entry per line)
- Max history size (e.g., 1000 entries)
- Current input preserved while browsing

Upstream: editor.ts history management
Depends on: input/editor component
title: Input history: up/down arrow navigation through prior inputs
